Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation Summary**

Thank you for the discovery call of 6 October 2026. Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has a customer service chatbot deployed on its support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. An internal audit finding in June 2026 recorded no inventory of AI systems. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027."

**What the Briefing Covers for Tamarack Instruments**

The Briefing maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to each of the three use cases. These are framed as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. Topics include:

- How the risk classification of the visual inspection system may be determined.
- Transparency expectations that may apply to a customer-facing chatbot.
- Where GDPR may be relevant across the use cases, alongside your constraint that customer data stays in the EU.

The session also responds to the internal audit finding by outlining what an AI system inventory could contain. It shows how the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen) structure a governance operating model. It considers how the frameworks listed in the Client profile (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 9001 and the internal audit function) might inform ISO/IEC 42001 preparation, for which a start date is not yet fixed. It also covers where consultation with the German works council fits in sequencing. Board-level accountability draws on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). Throughout, we apply three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and Price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The audience roles listed in the Client profile are:

- General Counsel
- CISO
- Head of Quality
- Head of Data
- German plant manager
- Two internal auditors

The fee is US$3,000. The session date is Unknown and will be agreed with you.

**What the Client Receives Afterward**

You will receive a summary memo recording:

- Decisions surfaced during the session.
- Readiness observations.
- Three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option.

The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

**Next Step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. On your confirmation, we will propose session dates and agree the attendee list with you.

Kind regards,
